note: Hydrogen's molar volume and R (GAME_SPEC §13.7, Stage 92; docs/CURRICULUM.md, experiment 28): a 250 mL conical flask of 20 mL of 1 M hydrochloric acid (0.02 mol in 19.3 g of water), a dish holding 0.050 g of magnesium ribbon (2.057 mmol; a 5 cm ribbon, its area as sixty grains'), and a 100 mL glass gas syringe, empty, its plunger free. The ribbon tipped in, the syringe put on the flask's mouth at once: the hydrogen pushes its plunger out, at the room's pressure, by about 49.5 mL at 20 C (hydrogen hardly dissolves): its volume over its moles, about 24 L/mol; R = PV / nT.
